name: JUnit Report Action
description: Report JUnit test results as annotations on Github Pull Request [junit]

token.description: Specify the token to use to publish the check.

github_token.description: Deprecated syntax to specify github token.

report_paths.description: Xml report paths in glob format

test_files_prefix.description: Prefix to add to test file paths from report files when annotating

exclude_sources.description: Comma seperated list of source folders to ignore for lookup

suite_regex.description: Regular expression for the named test suites

annotate_only.description: Enable to only annotate the results on the files, will not create a check run.

check_annotations.description: Defines if the checks will include annotations (This is different than `annotate_only`).

update_check.description: Defines if the active check should be updated instead

commit.description: Commit SHA to update the check status.

fail_on_failure.description: Fail the build in case a test failure occurred.

require_tests.description: Fail if no test are found.

require_passed_tests.description: Fail if no passed test are found.

include_passed.description: Include passed tests in the report

check_title_template.description: Template to configure the title format. Placeholders: {{FILE_NAME}}, {{SUITE_NAME}}, {{TEST_NAME}}, {{CLASS_NAME}}.

check_retries.description: If a testcase is retried, ignore the original failure.

transformers.description: Provide a regex pattern and target pattern

job_summary.description: Enables the publishing of a JOB_SUMMARY with the report.

detailed_summary.description: Include table with all test results in summary

annotate_notice.description: Annotate passed tests along with warning and failed ones

follow_symlink.description: Enables the file globber to follow symlinks. Default: false

job_name.description: Specify the name of a check to update

annotations_limit.description: Specify the limit for annotations. This will also interrupt parsing all test-suites if the limit is reached.

truncate_stack_traces.description: Truncate stack traces from test output to 2 lines in annotations
